module "OptNoDefault.dsf"

product 0 MaterialFunction "Functions/MF_LiOpt" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="InColor", InputType="Vector3", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : float3 @L2:C1 "InColor"
  %1 = FunctionInput(InputName="Strength", InputType="Scalar", IsOptional=true, SortPriority=1) : float @L2:C1 "Strength"
  %2 = Multiply(%0, %1) : float3 @L14:C20 "OutColor"
  %3 = FunctionOutput(%2, OutputName="OutColor", SortPriority=0) @L2:C1 "OutColor"
  inputs %0, %1
  outputs %3
